name: robowrite
description: Find and resume content work, create reviewed briefs, and read saved Markdown drafts with RoboWrite.

interface.shortDescription: Recover drafts and run reviewed RoboWrite content work.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to RoboWrite's hosted MCP server to inspect the signed-in organization, recover existing briefs and drafts, and run the reviewed URL-to-saved-Markdown workflow. Publication tools are not enabled. A RoboWrite account and organization are required. Browser OAuth for Codex still needs a CIMD or predefined client; do not treat this manifest as a completed ChatGPT or Codex listing.
defaultPrompt: Use RoboWrite to check the connected account. Make only get_account.
Show this month's drafts for my selected brand. Do not generate.
Read my brand voice and propose a brief. Do not save anything.
